== Description ==

Two paintings displayed on a wall, the left one the "Mount Krana" painting posted with the 2025 Beezer Bowl announcement. Shared the day before the 2025 Beezer Bowl (see [[2023 Beezer Bowl]]) with a reminder that it was not too late to come.
